(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have swap (d e : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) =
        (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [← sub_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, ite_mul, zero_mul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  intro d e f h
  have hd := ((hrelation d e).mp h.1).2
  have he := ((hrelation e f).mp h.2).2
  simp_rw [swap] at hd he
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul,
    Nat.cast_ofNat] at hs
  have hn : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    convert dvd_sub hs (dvd_mul_right (7 : ℤ) (digits_to_num d)) using 1 <;>
      rw [hdigits_to_num] <;> ring
  intro i
  have hi : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    convert dvd_sub hn (dvd_add (hd i) (he i)) using 1 <;> ring
  have hc : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 := ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩
  exact (hc.pow_right).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hi
